summary: Verified plan v2 of case-onboarding (design-only, 5 milestones, 22 steps) on all three lenses and rejected it. 66 (step, lens) verdicts: executability 19/22 pass, grounding 20/22 pass, testability 17/22 pass; 7 steps carry at least one refutation. 11 blockers and 11 warnings. All five Step 5 cross-step checks passed and the fit-tier re-tiering held on all 18 rows. Of the 19 blockers in the v1 verification, 10 were fixed by the planner and 9 were dissolved by the revised metadata-knowledge rule, which now tests for a fenced XML block rather than for a file named references/metadata-examples.md -- the grep was run over all 33 cited skills and every skill cited on a metadata step carries one. One v1 blocker survives: story-drafter still owns uat-test-cases.yaml, an output its contract does not produce. The other ten blockers are new, and three of them are defects in skill checkers rather than in the plan: a checker that exits 1 on every input, a checker that fails on the create-context flow the step is designed to produce, and a checker whose declared argument form demands an Apex class the step does not build. No gate was approved.
confidence_rationale: All three lenses ran on all 22 steps; no lens was skipped and no step returned no verdict. Every verdict cites a path read, a command run and its output, or a fixture executed. No refutation rests on a missing file: each of the eleven blockers rests on a contradiction between two things that exist -- a declared output against an agent's Output Contract, a declared test against the checker's observed exit code, a declared path against the cited skill's documented shape. Every checker's argument form was confirmed with --help and every cross-referential behaviour was confirmed by running it against a fixture rather than by reading its docstring.
